run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes to stdout
run_gmock_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate mock classes for specified classes
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file with virtual methods using gmock_class.py
generate_mock_for_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class by name from a header file
review_gmock_class_main: review the gmock_class main function that parses C++ headers and generates mock class output
